nodes.norm_label: v3 artefact subsystem design: the references-not-copies graph-rag artefact built natively in v3 — spine, reference triple, resolution, pipeline, probe, mapping key, chunks/tags, routing, facets, build-time validation.

nodes.label: Core principle: the graph indexes references into untouched authoritative raw source plus a derived semantic layer; content is resolved on demand, never stored as a mutated second copy (v1's c.content prose was the inversion).
nodes.norm_label: core principle: the graph indexes references into untouched authoritative raw source plus a derived semantic layer; content is resolved on demand, never stored as a mutated second copy (v1's c.content prose was the inversion).

nodes.label: A reference is {file_id, scheme, address}; the scheme (json_pointer / char_span / row / reference-only) is chosen by data shape, and rendered prose is a transient tagger view, never stored.
nodes.norm_label: a reference is {file_id, scheme, address}; the scheme (json_pointer / char_span / row / reference-only) is chosen by data shape, and rendered prose is a transient tagger view, never stored.

nodes.label: Resolution reads raw in place under data_root by relative path; identity is the content hash (file_id = sha256[:24]); the hash is verified on resolve and resolution fails loud on mismatch — no content-addressed store.
nodes.norm_label: resolution reads raw in place under data_root by relative path; identity is the content hash (file_id = sha256[:24]); the hash is verified on resolve and resolution fails loud on mismatch — no content-addressed store.

nodes.label: Stage-0 derive-corpus structurally quarantines RAG-unsafe surfaces (HERB eval oracle + team/customers membership links) into a corpus view the probe cannot sense; contamination is impossible by construction, the eval reads the oracle in place from raw.
nodes.norm_label: stage-0 derive-corpus structurally quarantines rag-unsafe surfaces (herb eval oracle + team/customers membership links) into a corpus view the probe cannot sense; contamination is impossible by construction, the eval reads the oracle in place from raw.

nodes.label: Pipeline: derive-corpus → scan → probe → reference → structure → tag → retrieve (Match→Filter→Rank→Cap), each arm reading references over the untouched corpus view.
nodes.norm_label: pipeline: derive-corpus → scan → probe → reference → structure → tag → retrieve (match→filter→rank→cap), each arm reading references over the untouched corpus view.

nodes.label: The shape probe climbs each parsed file and recovers the structural schema with zero meaning knowledge — one fused shape tree, repetition collapsed, per-field repetition ratio — describing shape + candidates only, leaving entity-vs-content to the mapping.
nodes.norm_label: the shape probe climbs each parsed file and recovers the structural schema with zero meaning knowledge — one fused shape tree, repetition collapsed, per-field repetition ratio — describing shape + candidates only, leaving entity-vs-content to the mapping.

nodes.label: The graph spine is closed canon: Source → File → Chunk → Tag are the only nodes; nothing else (records, branches, metadata directories) is materialized.
nodes.norm_label: the graph spine is closed canon: source → file → chunk → tag are the only nodes; nothing else (records, branches, metadata directories) is materialized.

nodes.label: Node-vs-attribute rule: a thing is a node only when others resolve through its facts or retrieval walks through it; otherwise it is an indexed attribute you filter or boost by, riding at the structural scope where the value sits.
nodes.norm_label: node-vs-attribute rule: a thing is a node only when others resolve through its facts or retrieval walks through it; otherwise it is an indexed attribute you filter or boost by, riding at the structural scope where the value sits.

nodes.label: Each emitted tag is its own per-chunk :Tag node bound to one chunk (no shared vocabulary); same phrase elsewhere is text equality, making retag/delete local and lossless, with a shared view derivable by normalized text.
nodes.norm_label: each emitted tag is its own per-chunk :tag node bound to one chunk (no shared vocabulary); same phrase elsewhere is text equality, making retag/delete local and lossless, with a shared view derivable by normalized text.

nodes.label: The mapping key is a per-dataset declarative settings file read by one generic loader: shape→handling is automatic (repetition ratio splits attribute vs raw), and only three meaning judgments — content choice, directories+kind, id-space assignment — are declared.
nodes.norm_label: the mapping key is a per-dataset declarative settings file read by one generic loader: shape→handling is automatic (repetition ratio splits attribute vs raw), and only three meaning judgments — content choice, directories+kind, id-space assignment — are declared.

nodes.label: A chunk is a coherent episode (thread/conversation/document), not a fixed-size window; the ~3000-token cap is a guardrail set at the tagger's effective focus span, not an embedder limit.
nodes.norm_label: a chunk is a coherent episode (thread/conversation/document), not a fixed-size window; the ~3000-token cap is a guardrail set at the tagger's effective focus span, not an embedder limit.

nodes.label: The chunk index is a materialized path of integer components — canonical source structure top to bottom, records included — with the subchunk split the only minted non-canonical tier (no parent node); the path does triple duty: ancestry, expansion, diversity.
nodes.norm_label: the chunk index is a materialized path of integer components — canonical source structure top to bottom, records included — with the subchunk split the only minted non-canonical tier (no parent node); the path does triple duty: ancestry, expansion, diversity.

nodes.label: One fully deterministic top-down seam-finder (no embeddings, no LLM) does episode segmentation and over-budget splitting, with per-content-kind seams dispatched by probe shape and a uniform walk-to-strongest-seam-and-recurse split rule, no minimum size.
nodes.norm_label: one fully deterministic top-down seam-finder (no embeddings, no llm) does episode segmentation and over-budget splitting, with per-content-kind seams dispatched by probe shape and a uniform walk-to-strongest-seam-and-recurse split rule, no minimum size.

nodes.label: One stateless temp-0 structured-output call per chunk (phrases out, no description, no numbers, instance discarded), graph-assembled context handed in as explicit input — statelessness is the precondition for build-time validation.
nodes.norm_label: one stateless temp-0 structured-output call per chunk (phrases out, no description, no numbers, instance discarded), graph-assembled context handed in as explicit input — statelessness is the precondition for build-time validation.

nodes.label: Facets are parallel relevance channels / a tag's character (not buckets): topic, process, stance, communicative-function, temporal-stance(TAM), allocated facts→structure and semantics→facets across seven converging linguistic traditions; the model emits no numbers.
nodes.norm_label: facets are parallel relevance channels / a tag's character (not buckets): topic, process, stance, communicative-function, temporal-stance(tam), allocated facts→structure and semantics→facets across seven converging linguistic traditions; the model emits no numbers.

nodes.label: Retrieval is weighted activation propagation (no hard filters): a prompt-conditioned weighted dot product accumulates per-facet channels at chunks, hard fields enter as soft boosts, and a deterministic exact single-anchor jump narrows with a loud automatic widen.
nodes.norm_label: retrieval is weighted activation propagation (no hard filters): a prompt-conditioned weighted dot product accumulates per-facet channels at chunks, hard fields enter as soft boosts, and a deterministic exact single-anchor jump narrows with a loud automatic widen.

nodes.label: A deterministic pre-pass matches the prompt against actual hard-field values read at query time through field connections (no pre-embedded value vocabulary): exact literals give strong boosts, the toolless one-shot interpreter flags type/wanted-vs-excluded, a scoped string-distance lookup catches typos.

nodes.norm_label: a chunk is a coherent episode, not a fixed-size window; the cap (3000 tokens) is the tagger focus-span guardrail that closes a packed run or splits an oversized unit, never a fill target.

nodes.label: Records-vs-prose is decided per position by content-kind: conversation streams (channel + adaptive time-gap episodes), prose-leaf records (one chunk per record, siblings never merged), short structured records (pack consecutive toward the cap).
nodes.norm_label: records-vs-prose is decided per position by content-kind: conversation streams (channel + adaptive time-gap episodes), prose-leaf records (one chunk per record, siblings never merged), short structured records (pack consecutive toward the cap).

nodes.norm_label: a chunk references its content leaves directly into untouched raw (the content projection, not inter-leaf bytes); the exact-tiling guarantee is per-leaf — an over-cap leaf char-span fragments tile that leaf exactly.

nodes.norm_label: v2 model contracts: the structured i/o at every model touchpoint (tagger, interpreter, embedder), inherited invariants, deliberately-absent contracts, and the sign-off checklist of judgment calls.

nodes.norm_label: a model touches an item in exactly three places — tagger (build, per chunk), interpreter (query, per prompt), embedder (build+query, per phrase) — everything else is deterministic and free.

nodes.label: Every contract inherits: no numbers cross the model boundary either direction; stateless temp-0 one-call-per-unit; schema-enforced output that fails loud; one shared async rate limiter; vocab-free model contexts.
nodes.norm_label: every contract inherits: no numbers cross the model boundary either direction; stateless temp-0 one-call-per-unit; schema-enforced output that fails loud; one shared async rate limiter; vocab-free model contexts.

nodes.label: The tagger contract: one temp-0 call per chunk over a chunk-envelope, emitting open contextual-phrase lists (topic/process/stance) plus closed-enum chunk attributes (function/temporal_stance), source-language, no numbers.
nodes.norm_label: the tagger contract: one temp-0 call per chunk over a chunk-envelope, emitting open contextual-phrase lists (topic/process/stance) plus closed-enum chunk attributes (function/temporal_stance), source-language, no numbers.

nodes.label: The interpreter contract: one toolless temp-0 call per prompt emitting literals (kind+polarity), prompt-side facet phrases, a structural date_range, and answer_shape — extracting exactly the axes retrieval uses, no coefficients.
nodes.norm_label: the interpreter contract: one toolless temp-0 call per prompt emitting literals (kind+polarity), prompt-side facet phrases, a structural date_range, and answer_shape — extracting exactly the axes retrieval uses, no coefficients.

nodes.label: The embedder contract: the asymmetric nv-embedqa-1b-v2 embeds exactly one thing — phrase tags (passage) and their prompt-side facet mirror (query) — at native 2048 dims, L2-normalized, under the shared limiter.
nodes.norm_label: the embedder contract: the asymmetric nv-embedqa-1b-v2 embeds exactly one thing — phrase tags (passage) and their prompt-side facet mirror (query) — at native 2048 dims, l2-normalized, under the shared limiter.

nodes.label: MUST-NOT rule: ids, dates/years, URLs, PR numbers, and channel ids never appear in tagger output — those are facts that become structure (the v1 pollution); enforced as promptfoo regression assertions with no model in the loop.
nodes.norm_label: must-not rule: ids, dates/years, urls, pr numbers, and channel ids never appear in tagger output — those are facts that become structure (the v1 pollution); enforced as promptfoo regression assertions with no model in the loop.
